name: progress-status
description: Task-progress bar (done/total) and context-window token bar (used/limit): a status line in the terminal, a band above the prompt in the desktop app.

keepTaskList.title: Ask Claude to keep a task list
keepTaskList.description: Adds one line to Claude's instructions: when a request has 3 or more steps, keep a task list and update it as each step finishes, so the progress bar has something to show.

autoPlan.title: Make a task list when Claude has none
autoPlan.description: When Claude works on a request without a task list, a small fast model splits the request into steps and shows them as pills. Costs one small extra model call per such request.

amberAt.title: Context turns amber at (%)
amberAt.description: The Context bar and ring turn amber from this percent of the context window. Default 50.

redAt.title: Context turns red at (%)
redAt.description: The Context bar and ring turn red from this percent. Must be higher than the amber point, or both go back to 50 and 80. Default 80.
